title: Keep, move or remove the Flashbots getBundleStatsV2 telemetry

options.name: Keep current behaviour: query stats on every attempt inside the nonce lock, log any error
options.risk: An extra relay round trip under the lock on every ETH attempt (up to 5 min if the relay hangs) and operator guidance that may point at empty logs if the endpoint is dead (AUD-TX-006).

options.name: Remove the call and the operator text that relies on it; reconcile by receipts only
options.risk: Lose the builder-coverage diagnosis if the endpoint still works.

options.name: Keep the telemetry but run it after the lock is released, with a short timeout
options.risk: Slightly more code; still useless if the endpoint is dead.

recommendation: Verify the endpoint in Phase 23; then remove if dead (research recommendation), otherwise move-out-of-lock.
default: Keep current behaviour until the owning phase decides (milestone contract); S3, no capital effect.
behavior_impact: Telemetry only, plus a small amount of nonce-lock time.
needed_by: Phase 29 discussion (S2-S4 fixes), after the Phase 23 endpoint check
